# Become the Snake

**Version 1.2** · for Crusader Kings III 1.20.* · [Steam Workshop](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2232605324) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) · [All versions](https://github.com/nchelix/ck3-mods-public/releases?q=become-snake&expanded=true)

Don't step on snek.

Turn any character in the world into a snake. Not literally a snake, sadly --
the game draws the line somewhere -- but scaled skin, bloodshot eyes and no
eyebrows gets you most of the way there.

You can stop at scales, go all the way to a milk-eyed serpent, or found a
bloodline so your whole dynasty is born that way. It is purely cosmetic. No
stats, no bonuses, just a court full of things that should not be sitting on
thrones.

---

## Three ways to be a snake

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Become A Snake** | Scales, bloodshot eyes, no eyebrows. Stops with them. |
| **Become Fully A Snake** | Heavier scales, no lashes, colder skin, eyes gone milk-pale. |
| **Found a Snake Bloodline** | The scales, inherited by every child born afterwards. |

There is also **Make Their Children Snakes**, which brings a character's
existing children into the bloodline.

## How to use it

Right-click any character, yourself included, and the options are under friendly
interactions.

Changed your mind? Snakes are weird. **No More Snake** puts them back.

## What actually changes

- **Skin** takes on scales
- **Eyes** turn bloodshot
- **Eyebrows** disappear entirely
- **Colouring** shifts to something colder

The change builds on the character's own genes rather than replacing them, so
the result still looks like that particular person, only considerably worse.
Facial structure and age are untouched.

## If you tried this mod before and nothing happened

That was a real problem, and it is fixed. The scales used to sit behind the
game's **disturbing portrait modifiers** setting — the same one that governs
leprosy sores and plague buboes — so anyone playing with that switched off
applied the trait and saw absolutely nothing.

Scales are about as alarming as a birthmark, so the basic look is no longer
gated. Try it again.

**Become Fully A Snake** is still gated, because that one has earned it. If
the full serpent does not appear for you, that setting is why.

## Things to know

- **Purely cosmetic.** No modifiers, no opinion effects, no gameplay impact
  of any kind.
- **Fully reversible**, at any time, with no cooldown.
- **Works on anyone**, not just your own dynasty.
- **One at a time.** The three looks are mutually exclusive.

## Compatibility

- Built and tested against **CK3 1.19 "Scribe"**.
- **Ironman and achievements:** this mod will disable achievements, as
  gameplay mods do.
- **Other mods:** it adds three traits and five interactions, and
  overwrites no base game file. Other portrait mods touching the same genes
  may fight over the result.
- **Existing saves:** safe to add mid-game. Remove the mod and affected
  characters simply revert to their normal appearance.

## Languages

Available in all nine languages the game supports. English is fully written;
the other eight currently show the English wording. Translations are welcome.

## Install

- **Steam Workshop:** subscribe on the Workshop page above.
- **Manually, any version:** download `become-snake-v<version>.zip` from the [releases](https://github.com/nchelix/ck3-mods-public/releases?q=become-snake&expanded=true) and extract it into `Documents/Paradox Interactive/Crusader Kings III/mod/`, then enable it in the launcher.
